title: Model Pin & Performance Snapshot: Console workflow for targeted rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a compact console workflow that lets users pin a specific model version to a route and attach/publish a performance profile (latency/cost/quality) with quick compare to other versions.
background: Customers struggle to safely pin model versions because console UIs either expose too many knobs or lack immediate perf tradeoffs. We need a streamlined flow that surfaces performance profiles and rollout controls to reduce risky pins and improve time-to-rollback.
proposed_solution: Introduce a 'Pin version' modal from the route editor that shows a Performance Snapshot card for selected version: p50/p90 latency, tokens/sec cost estimate, quality score (from evals), and compatibility notes. Allow quick A/B compare to currently pinned version and an option to publish the snapshot as the canonical 'performance profile' for that model version. Provide canary % and duration controls and a 'auto-fallback' toggle. Store pin as route configuration and expose in rollout history.
acceptance_criteria: Users can select a model version and open a modal that displays the Performance Snapshot for that version
Users can compare two versions side-by-side (selected vs current) showing p50/p90 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and quality delta
Users can set canary percentage and duration, start rollout, and see rollout progress in the route timeline
Users can 'Publish Performance Profile' which creates a named profile visible in the model's version details and in the public performance catalog
Pins and published profiles are audited (actor, timestamp) and surfaced in console activity logs
Rollback action available from rollout history within the UI
notes: Design will default to showing percentile latency and cost for 1k tokens; deeper metrics available in model detail page
We will reuse existing rollout APIs; engineering prefers storing profile refs instead of duplicating metric snapshots
Decision: a published performance profile is immutable; an update creates a new profile version to preserve audit trail
Edge case: if performance telemetry is sparse, show 'insufficient data' CTA that links to eval-run creation
